proposedFields.title: The Midnight Greenhouse
proposedFields.setting: A locked greenhouse behind a manor, smelling of soil and bitter almond.

statements.text: I was reading in the library all evening.
I was in the kitchen the whole time.
I saw the gardener in the greenhouse at that hour.

clues.text: The shears were found wiped clean in the widow's coat pocket.
A witness firmly places the widow in the greenhouse at the time of the murder.
The widow stood to inherit the estate and argued with Edgar that week.
The gardener had access to the shears earlier in the day.
The gardener had recently been threatened with dismissal.
The gardener is firmly placed in the kitchen at the time of the murder.
